generators.carrier: label map U from oriented edge representatives to supplied group G
label of reversed traversal, defined as inverse of U e
ordered product of edge labels along a walk, fixed multiplication order

relations.statement: U(reverse e) = (U e)^-1 for every oriented edge representative e
relations.hypotheses: G is a group; the multigraph is finite; reversal is an involution on oriented edges

relations.statement: holonomy(w1 ++ w2) = holonomy(w1) * holonomy(w2) in a fixed order convention
relations.hypotheses: G associative with identity; w1 ends where w2 starts

relations.statement: With forest transport T, dressing by (T v)^-1 neutralizes every edge iff U e * T(src e) = T(dst e) for every edge

lemmas.statement: Reverse label of reverse is the original label: ((U e)^-1)^-1 = U e
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem reverse_involutive {G : Type*} [Group G] (u : G) : (u⁻¹)⁻¹ = u := inv_inv u

near_misses.claim: Holonomy of a walk is independent of multiplication order in a general group
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: G may be non-abelian, so order of multiplication matters

near_misses.claim: Reverse traversal carries the same label as forward traversal
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The inverse-edge convention requires the inverse label unless the label has order at most 2
